name: RUST_Bench
description: RUST_Bench is a benchmark focused on evaluating models' ability to generate and repair Rust code. It contains a collection of Rust programming tasks (e.g., code generation, completion, and bug fixing) accompanied by test cases to verify functional correctness. The benchmark measures whether generated code passes provided tests and handles common Rust idioms and error patterns.
reputation: niche dataset hosted on Hugging Face with limited community adoption compared to mainstream code benchmarks
